readmeMarkdown:
Refract

Reverse-engineer any live website into W3C Design Tokens, CSS variables, Tailwind v4/v3 themes, structured UI ontologies, and agent-ready DESIGN.md specs.

Multi-provider plugin for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, and Cursor — plus a zero-dependency Node.js CLI.

--- ## Why Refract? Asking an AI agent to "copy this website's style" from a single screenshot hallucinates hex codes, misses dark-mode overrides, guesses hover/focus transitions, and blurs visual tokens with layout structure. **Refract** measures first and refines second: | Capability | Screenshot-Only Prompting | **Refract** | | --- | --- | --- | | **Color & Contrast** | Approximated hex values | Exact CSS variables + computed colors + WCAG 2.1 contrast pairing | | **Themes & Viewports** | Single static frame | Multi-state matrix (`desktop-light`, `desktop-dark`, `mobile-light`) | | **Interactive States** | Ignored or invented | Live Playwright `:hover` & `:focus-visible` style delta probing | | **UI Ontology** | Unstructured prose | Formal YAML/JSON regions, component slots, composition & invariants | | **Output Portability** | One-off CSS | W3C DTCG JSON, CSS vars, Tailwind v4 `@theme`, Tailwind v3 config, `DESIGN.md` | ## How It Works ```mermaid flowchart LR URL["Live Referent URL"] --> CAP["capture-referent.mjs (playwright-cli)"] CAP --> RAW["raw/capture.json + *.png + *.snapshot.yaml"] RAW --> COMPILE["compile-artifacts.mjs"] COMPILE --> OUT["tokens.dtcg.json · tokens.css · tailwind · ui-ontology · DESIGN.md"] OUT --> VAL["validate-artifacts.mjs"] VAL --> AGENT["Agent Visual & Semantic Refinement"] ``` --- ## Prerequisites - **Node.js `>= 18`** (uses built-in `node:*` APIs only — **zero external npm packages**) - **`playwright-cli`** available on `PATH` (or via `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_BIN`) with Chromium installed --- ## Quick Start ### Claude Code Run directly with a local checkout: ```bash claude --plugin-dir /path/to/refract ``` Or install from a GitHub marketplace (on Claude Code 2.1.275+): ```text /plugin install refract --marketplace tammai/refract ``` Validate strictly: ```bash claude plugin validate --strict /path/to/refract ``` Invoke inside Claude Code: - `/refract:extract-referent https://example.com --out ./design-referent` - `/refract:audit-ui-ontology ./design-referent` - Delegate to the **`referent-analyst`** subagent ### Antigravity Validate and install locally: ```bash agy plugin validate --strict /path/to/refract agy plugin install /path/to/refract ``` Invoke inside Antigravity: - `/extract-referent` or `/audit-ui-ontology` - `agy --agent referent-analyst` ### Codex Install from a Codex marketplace repository (using `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`) or install skills locally into `~/.agents/skills/`: ```bash mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills ln -s /path/to/refract/skills/extract-referent ~/.agents/skills/extract-referent ln -s /path/to/refract/skills/audit-ui-ontology ~/.agents/skills/audit-ui-ontology ``` Invoke inside Codex: - `$extract-referent https://example.com --out ./design-referent` - `$audit-ui-ontology ./design-referent` ### Cursor Install as a Cursor plugin (configured via `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`), or copy `.cursor/rules/refract-guardrails.mdc` and `skills/` into a project: - Invoke skills in Agent chat via `/extract-referent` or `/audit-ui-ontology` - Delegate to the bundled **`referent-analyst`** agent - Guardrails in `.cursor/rules/refract-guardrails.mdc` apply automatically when working with referent extractions or `DESIGN.md` ### Standalone CLI Run the full capture + compile + validation pipeline from any terminal: ```bash node skills/extract-referent/scripts/capture-referent.mjs https://example.com \ --out ./referent-output \ --compile ``` --- ## Output Artifacts Every run produces raw multi-state captures in `raw/` plus **7 validated artifacts** (see [Output Formats](docs/output-formats.md) for full schemas): | Artifact | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `tokens.dtcg.json` | Three-tier (`primitive` → `semantic` → `component` + `modes.dark`) W3C DTCG JSON | | `tokens.css` | CSS custom properties with `:root`, `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, and `.dark` | | `tailwind.theme.css` | Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` configuration | | `tailwind.config.mjs` | Tailwind CSS v3 `theme.extend` ESM configuration | | `ui-ontology.yaml` | Human-readable regions, surfaces, component slots, state deltas & invariants | | `ui-ontology.json` | Machine-readable JSON mirror of the UI ontology | | `DESIGN.md` | Agent-ready design specification with concrete DO / DON'T reproduction rules | --- ## Documentation & Guides - [**Getting Started**](docs/getting-started.md) — Setup, CLI flags, and workflows for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, and standalone CLI - [**Architecture**](docs/architecture.md) — Multi-state capture matrix, color clustering, WCAG pairing, and multi-provider layout - [**Output Formats**](docs/output-formats.md) — Detailed reference and integration snippets for all 7 output artifacts - [**Troubleshooting**](docs/troubleshooting.md) — Resolving `PATH`, SPA hydration delays, CORS stylesheets, and alias checks - [**GitHub SEO & Launch Guide**](docs/github-seo.md) — Repository topics, About description, `social-preview.svg`, and marketplace checklist - [**Wiki**](wiki/Home.md) — Complete multi-page knowledge base (also publishable to [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/tammai/refract/wiki)) --- ## FAQ
Does Refract support Tailwind CSS v4 and v3? Yes. Every extraction emits both `tailwind.theme.css` (`@theme { ... }` for Tailwind v4) and `tailwind.config.mjs` (`theme.extend` ESM config for Tailwind v3).
Does it work on React, Next.js, or client-rendered SPAs? Yes. `capture-referent.mjs` drives a real headless Chromium browser via `playwright-cli`, waits for `document.fonts.ready` plus a configurable `--wait` delay, and reads live computed styles and DOM/ARIA trees after hydration.
How are light and dark themes captured? By default, Refract captures `desktop-light` (`1440×900`, `light`), `desktop-dark` (`1440×900`, `dark`), and `mobile-light` (`390×844`, `light`). Measured dark-mode differences are emitted automatically under `modes.dark` in `tokens.dtcg.json` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` / `.dark` in `tokens.css`.
Does Refract check WCAG contrast and accessibility? Yes. Refract alpha-composites the effective opaque background behind sampled text elements to compute WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios, audits heading level order (`h1`–`h6`), probes `:focus-visible` outlines, and counts mobile interactive touch targets under `44×44px`.
--- ## Contributing, Security & License - Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development guidelines and CI checks. - Read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for safe capture practices and vulnerability reporting. - See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history. - Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
latestReleaseNotes:
Multi-provider release expanding **Refract** to **OpenAI Codex** and **Cursor** alongside **Claude Code** and **Antigravity**, with enriched guides and a full GitHub Wiki.

### Highlights
- **OpenAI Codex support**: Added `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` mapping `skills/` with marketplace `interface` metadata, `$extract-referent` / `$audit-ui-ontology` invocation docs, and local `~/.agents/skills/` setup instructions
- **Cursor support**: Added `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` and `.cursor/rules/refract-guardrails.mdc` (`alwaysApply: false` intelligent rule) wired cleanly alongside `skills/` and `agents/` without conflicting with Antigravity's `rules/AGENTS.md`
- **Multi-provider CI validation**: Extended `.github/workflows/validate.yml` to verify all 4 provider manifests, referenced assets/directories, Codex field constraints, and Cursor `.mdc` frontmatter
- **Docs, Guides & GitHub Wiki**: Added Provider Support Matrix, component discovery isolation guide, `DESIGN.md` wiring instructions, Codex/Cursor troubleshooting, and a 9-page [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/tammai/refract/wiki)
- **README badge rendering fix**: Wrapped all shields.io badges with section links and explicit `height="20"` for consistent inline rendering across local Markdown viewers and GitHub

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tammai/refract/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
